query:
WITH LatestChanges AS (
                SELECT  [code],[type],[locnum],[revnum],[lowdate],[highdate],[text],[uselocnum],__$operation,__$start_lsn,__$seqval, 

  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY code,loctypenum,uselocnum ORDER BY [__$seqval] DESC) AS rn 
                
  FROM [cdc].[dbo_wclocnam_CT] 
                WHERE [__$operation] IN (1, 2, 4) AND __$start_lsn > 0x0
            )
            SELECT [code],[type],[locnum],[revnum],[lowdate],[highdate],[text],[uselocnum],[address1],[address2],[city],[state],[zipcode],[county],[title],[parttime],[fulltime],[sttin],[biztype],[biztypex],[enteredon],[enteredby],[updateon],[updateby],[renewoflocnum],[locytdprem],[locstfees],[classcode],[exposure],[rate],[sttintype],[firstname],[lastname],[loctypenum],[latitude],[longitude],[geostatus],[geoage],TRIM([gender]) AS [gender],TRIM([maritalstatus]) AS [maritalstatus],[plindustry],[occupation],__$operation,__$start_lsn,__$seqval FROM LatestChanges WHERE rn = 1

SELECT
            [code],[type],[locnum],[revnum],[lowdate],[highdate],[text],[uselocnum],None AS dl_watermark
        
  FROM dbo.wclocnam
        WHERE None > CAST('0x00734b650000b5080101' AS datetime2)
